inspector.label:
Hybrid Layering
        Relative to Sprites
        
          Behind Sprites
          In Front of Sprites
        
        Available to transparent Meshes and Billboards. Both choices depth-test against opaque 3D; neither is an x-ray. The saved choice is retained while the material is opaque.

checks.spriteReadOnly: Hybrid Layering (read-only)Sprites always draw as one contiguous pass: after opaque depth and Behind Sprites transparency, before In Front of Sprites transparency. Transform Z is tested against opaque depth; Sprite order is Sorting Layer, Order in Layer, then stable Object ID.
checks.projectHelp: Hybrid Scene LayeringPass order: Opaque 3D → transparent Meshes/Billboards Behind Sprites → the complete Sprite pass → transparent Meshes/Billboards In Front of Sprites. Transparent bands depth-test but do not write depth. Sprite Z only interacts spatially with opaque depth.

limitations: Bounded two-band alpha transparency; universal order-independent transparency remains out of scope.
